name: West start
label: Start
description: West end of Water Eaton Road, on the railway bridge. Open ground and the backs of Duncombe Street to the north. Station Footpath is about 220 m away, Oliver Road about 290 m.

name: East start
label: Start
description: East end of Water Eaton Road, by the roadworks barriers. Clifford Avenue runs north from here. Oliver Road is about 280 m away, Station Footpath about 330 m.

name: Station Footpath
description: North-west corner: the lane up to Bletchley station. Old checkpoint by the abandoned police car. Find the red smoke, then stand in the green zone for 10 seconds.

name: Oliver Road
description: Top of Oliver Road, at the hoarding by the old Sainsbury's. Red smoke marks the checkpoint. Stand in the green zone for 10 seconds.

name: Scav spawn S-01
label: S-01
description: Duncombe Street, just south of the Osborne Street junction. Covers the road both ways.

name: Scav spawn S-02
label: S-02
description: Back gardens on the west side of Duncombe Street, by the corner houses.

name: Scav spawn S-03
label: S-03
description: South side of Osborne Street, between the semis. Close to two open houses.

name: Scav spawn S-04
label: S-04
description: Middle of the car park. Marked as a lookout: long sightlines, no cover.

name: Scav spawn S-05
label: S-05
description: South end of Clifford Avenue. Watches the road and the open house on the corner.

name: Scav spawn S-06
label: S-06
description: Southern stretch of Duncombe Street, by the burning barrel and an open end-terrace.

name: Scav spawn S-07
label: S-07
description: Eastern half of the car park, right next to a crate spot.

name: Scav spawn S-08
label: S-08
description: Grass strip at the corner of the old Sainsbury's. Overlooks the car park and the gardens behind Osborne Street.

name: Scav spawn S-09
label: S-09
description: Where Osborne Street meets Oliver Road, on the way to the Oliver Road exit.

name: Scav spawn S-10
label: S-10
description: Open ground by the railway, west of the back gardens. Sound carries a long way here.

name: Scav spawn S-11
label: S-11
description: West end of Osborne Street, near the Duncombe Street junction.

name: Scav spawn S-12
label: S-12
description: Overgrown back gardens behind Clifford Avenue, just south of the two-storey house.

name: Crate C-01
description: Inside the open house at the north end of the railway-side terrace.

name: Crate C-02
description: Out in the car park, with no cover while you search it. S-07 spawns next to it.

name: Crate C-03
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace, by a shed.

name: Crate C-04
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace.

name: Crate C-05
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace, by a shed.

name: Crate C-06
description: Inside the small open building in the gardens west of Duncombe Street.

name: Crate C-07
description: At the retirement home off Clifford Avenue, by the east fence.

name: Crate C-08
description: Inside the open house on the corner of Osborne Street and Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-09
description: Inside the open semi on the south side of Osborne Street.

name: Crate C-10
description: Inside the two-storey house. The field copy flags it for loot.

name: Crate C-11
description: By a shed out on the open ground, west of the gardens.

name: Crate C-12
description: Inside the open semi on Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-13
description: Back garden on the west side of the Duncombe Street terrace.

name: Crate C-14
description: Inside the open end-terrace on the east side of Duncombe Street.

name: Crate C-15
description: Inside the open house towards the south end of Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-16
description: Inside the open house at the south end of Duncombe Street.

name: Crate C-17
description: Inside the open house on the south side of Water Eaton Road.

name: Railway terrace, north end
description: End house of the terrace that backs onto the railway. Crate C-01 inside.

name: Garden outbuilding
description: Small single-storey building in the gardens west of Duncombe Street. Crate C-06 inside.

name: Osborne Street semi
description: South side of Osborne Street. Crate C-09 inside.

name: Clifford Avenue corner house
description: Where Osborne Street turns into Clifford Avenue. Crate C-08 inside.

name: The two-storey
description: Set back among the trees behind Osborne Street. Two floors and crate C-10. S-03 and S-12 both spawn close by.

name: Clifford Avenue semi
description: West side of Clifford Avenue. Crate C-12 inside.

name: Duncombe Street end-terrace
description: East side of Duncombe Street, by the burning barrel. Crate C-14 inside.

name: Duncombe Street, south end
description: Last houses before Water Eaton Road. Crate C-16 inside.

name: Clifford Avenue, south
description: West side of Clifford Avenue, near S-05. Crate C-15 inside.

name: Water Eaton Road house
description: South side of Water Eaton Road, the nearest open house to the east start. Crate C-17 inside.

name: The car park
description: The old Sainsbury's car park. Open ground with no cover and long sightlines. Cross it quickly or go round the edge.

name: The old Sainsbury's
description: The big retail unit north of the car park. Shut and locked. Its hoarding marks the Oliver Road exit.

name: MK Jamee Masjid
description: The masjid in the terrace on the west side of Duncombe Street. A useful landmark when you're navigating the gardens.

name: The railway
description: The West Coast Main Line runs down the west edge of the raid. Out of bounds past the fence. Movement near the tracks is noisy and carries a long way.

name: Community house
description: On Duncombe Street, by the way into the car park.

name: Retirement home
description: Long, low block off Clifford Avenue against the east fence. Crate C-07 is here.

name: Brunel Shopping Centre
description: Out of bounds to the north, but visible from the car park.
